from dataclasses import asdict
import hashlib, json, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT = Path.cwd()
def deep():
    from development.tools.benchmark_large_month import _service, MONTH_START_MS, NOW_MS
    from development.tests.fixtures.synthetic_month import SyntheticMonthSource
    from src.cache import CacheDatabase, CacheRepository
    from src.config import load_configuration

    source = SyntheticMonthSource(100, 50, month_start_ms=MONTH_START_MS)
    config = dict(load_configuration(ROOT).values)
    config["timezone"] = "UTC"
    result = {}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
        database = CacheDatabase(Path(directory))
        database.initialize()
        repository = CacheRepository(database)
        for phase in ("cold", "warm"):
            source.metrics.counts.clear()
            source.metrics.milliseconds.clear()
            before = source.load_count
            revisions = source.revision_count
            service = _service(source, repository, config)
            wall = time.perf_counter()
            cpu = time.process_time()
            report = service.build_token_mix_history()
            cpu = time.process_time() - cpu
            wall = time.perf_counter() - wall
            encoded = json.dumps(asdict(report), sort_keys=True, default=str, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
            result[phase] = {
                "wall_seconds": wall, "cpu_seconds": cpu,
                "hydrations": source.load_count - before,
                "revision_checks": source.revision_count - revisions,
                "sample_prompts": report.token_mix.sample_size,
                "calls": sum(row.calls for row in report.model_token_mix),
                "output_sha256": hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest(),
                "acquisition": service.metrics.snapshot(),
            }
            assert report.token_mix.sample_size == 5000
            assert result[phase]["calls"] == 5000
            assert result[phase]["hydrations"] == (100 if phase == "cold" else 0)
            assert not service._analyzed, "Deep scans must release analyzed snapshots"
    assert result["cold"]["output_sha256"] == result["warm"]["output_sha256"]
    print(json.dumps(result))
deep()
